The trail is short enough to follow by hand and long enough to catch a farm. The sonnet points at a person the farm never met, the willow points at a sum the farm never owned, the nadir points at a year the farm never lived. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Brick maker glaze pot mark fired in the brickyard: the toll is each glaze pot is a brick pressed beside the maker's mark, paid in the open.
